groups.merge_rationale: Singleton: this sets queen-size as the minimum acceptable main bed, with king acceptable as an upgrade, but does not express a king-first default.
Singleton: this explicitly prefers king first while allowing queen as a fallback, which differs from a queen-minimum default and from a strict/default king-bed request.
Both express the same default hotel bed configuration when separate beds are not needed: request or prefer a single king-sized bed.
Singleton: this constrains the room to exactly one bed but leaves mattress size unspecified, so it is not equivalent to king-size or queen-minimum preferences.
